accessibility_notes: Ensure contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for all text against dark backgrounds.
Use semantic HTML5 tags (main, nav, article).
All interactive elements must have aria-labels.
Map markers must have tooltips accessible via keyboard navigation.
